messages.author: 35cf403e5052bfe0
messages.subject: compile error
parts:
I have been running numerous nimble code models recently
and have had no problems at all, using the nimbleModel-compileNimble-configureMCMC-buildMCMC -compileNimble sequence
However now when I compile, following an apparently successful  call to nimbleModel, I get the following compile error:
 
CLCOV<-compileNimble(LCOV)
compiling... this may take a minute. Use 'showCompilerOutput = TRUE' to see C++ compilation details.
Error in file(con, open = "w") : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In dir.create(dirName) :
  cannot create dir 'C:\Users\abl6\AppData\Local\Temp\Rtmp0YP1zN\nimble_generatedCode', reason 'No such file or directory'
2: In file(con, open = "w") :
  cannot open file 'C:\Users\abl6\AppData\Local\Temp\Rtmp0YP1zN/nimble_generatedCode/P_1_COVID.h': No such file or directory
 
I can supply the full code if need be, but if there is a simple fix
that would be much appreciated.
 
best
Andrew

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: compile error
parts:
Hmm, odd. That looks like a filesystem problem, which might not be
related to nimble.

1) Before running compileNimble, you could try making sure the
expected R tempdir exists. To find the R tempdir, do "tempdir()".
Then see if this directory exists (but where you replace XYZ based on
what you see from tempdir():

C:\Users\abl6\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpXYZ

If it exists, see if it is possible to create files or directories
within it, which is what NIMBLE needs to be able to do.

2) You could also try using the dirName argument to compileNimble to
be a filesystem location where you know you have permission to create
files.

-chris

messages.subject: RE: compile error
parts:
Hi Chris
Thanks for the advice on the folder creation issue.
I did use the
compileNimble(....dirName=.....)
with an already created folder and it worked fine.
Since then I have run various models and had no problems
without using the dirName argument in compileNimble

It is some issue with R creating folders on Windows I guess , but appears to
be temporary.

Thanks again
Andrew
